comment_regular: Authoritative Oblivion INFO condition gate. Rejects Deleted INFOs, null parent quests, and SayOnce INFOs whose INFO-global spoken byte is set. Otherwise evaluates quest conditions at +0x50 followed by INFO conditions at +0x18 as one continued stream; lowDispositionFailure is set only by a failed GetDisposition >/>= test.
